protocol.name: LENGEN - Lentiviral Generation, Packaging and Transduction

reagents.name: HEK293T_cells
reagents.role: Producer cell line for lentiviral packaging

reagents.name: ViralSupernatant
reagents.role: Cell-free lentiviral harvest from HEK293T production site
reagents.note: Modelled as fresh dispense in .bs to represent supernatant collection step; cells remain adhered to hydrophilic spot

reagents.name: TrypsinEDTA
reagents.role: Cell detachment reagent for harvest and expansion

reagents.name: sgRNA_Cas9_Plasmid
reagents.role: All-in-one Cas9 + sgRNA targeting ESR1 (Step 10, optional)

detection_modules.name: geneKnockoutDetection
detection_modules.note: Not directly called as detect module in corrected .bs; downstream of crisprCells trypsinization

cfg_structure.note: CFG derived from corrected .bs; verified against lengen_lentiviral_main_dag.dot

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Entry block: Steps 1-8 (producer seeding, mastermix, transfection, viral harvest, target seeding, serial dilution, transduction, mCherry detection)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_2_t
basic_blocks.description: mCherry QC pass: signal_1_3 > 0; dispose transduction droplets

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_3_f
basic_blocks.description: mCherry QC fail: signal_1_3 <= 0; drain transduction droplets
basic_blocks.note: IR emits dispose for drain (known compiler limitation in lilott8/BioScript ir_target); .bs source is correct

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_4_j
basic_blocks.description: qcJoin: dispose all main-branch signal droplets; enter shRNA branch (Step 9)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_5_t
basic_blocks.description: shRNA QC pass: shrnaSignal > 0; dispose shrnaCells

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_6_f
basic_blocks.description: shRNA QC fail: shrnaSignal <= 0; drain shrnaCells
basic_blocks.note: IR emits dispose for drain (known compiler limitation)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_7_j
basic_blocks.description: shrnaJoin: dispose shrnaSignal; enter CRISPR branch (Step 10)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_8_t
basic_blocks.description: CRISPR QC pass: crisprMCherry > 0; dispose crisprCells

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_9_f
basic_blocks.description: CRISPR QC fail: crisprMCherry <= 0; drain crisprCells
basic_blocks.note: IR emits dispose for drain (known compiler limitation)

basic_blocks.label: bsbbif_10_j
basic_blocks.description: finalCleanup: dispose crisprMCherry; NOP terminal node

steps.name: Seed HEK293T Producer Cells
steps.description: Dispense HEK293T cells with Pluronics F-127 onto the 1.6 mm hydrophilic production site via passive dispensing.

steps.name: Prepare Lipofectamine-DNA Mastermix
steps.description: Co-transfection mastermix containing four plasmids combined with Lipofectamine 3000 and P3000 in Opti-MEM, supplemented with Pluronics F-127 for DMF actuation.
mixing_order: Combine plasmid pool with lipofection reagents (5s)
Add Pluronics F-127 (20m mix + 20m heat at 25c)

incubation.purpose: DNA-liposomal complex formation at room temperature

steps.name: Transfect HEK293T Cells
steps.description: Actuate lipofectamine mastermix onto seeded HEK293T cells using the four-prong electrode production area. Circulate droplet for uniform mixing to replicate reverse transfection (adding transfection mixture to unseeded cells).

steps.name: Lentiviral Particle Production and Supernatant Harvest
steps.description: Incubate transfected HEK293T cells for 24h to allow lentiviral particle accumulation in the supernatant. Cells remain adhered to hydrophilic spot; viral supernatant is collected by electrode actuation.
steps.note: ViralSupernatant manifest in .bs models the cell-free harvest; actual supernatant is the HEK293T culture medium post-production

steps.name: Seed Target Cells
bs_ops: dispense TargetCells x4 + dispense PluronicF127 x4
steps.description: Dispense four independent target cell droplets onto four 1.2 mm transduction sites via highway track passive dispensing. One droplet per dilution to satisfy BioScript use-once type system.

steps.name: Serial Dilution of Viral Supernatant
bs_ops: mix dmem1 with viralSupernatant for 5s -> dilution_1_3
mix dmem2 with dilution_1_3 for 5s  -> dilution_1_6
mix dmem3 with dilution_1_6 for 5s  -> dilution_1_12
mix dmem4 with dilution_1_12 for 5s -> dilution_1_24
steps.description: Generate four serial dilutions of the lentiviral supernatant using DMEM + polybrene as diluent via highway track electrode actuation (~98% accuracy).

steps.name: Transduce Target Cells
bs_ops: mix dilution_1_3  with targetSuspension1 for 24h -> transduction_1_3
mix dilution_1_6  with targetSuspension2 for 24h -> transduction_1_6
mix dilution_1_12 with targetSuspension3 for 24h -> transduction_1_12
mix dilution_1_24 with targetSuspension4 for 24h -> transduction_1_24
steps.description: Deliver each dilution to its own target cell site via highway track one-directional electrode actuation. Incubation encoded in mix duration per BioScript reference syntax.

steps.name: mCherry Fluorescence Detection and Viral Titer Calculation
bs_ops: detect mCherryDetection on transduction_1_3  for 30s -> signal_1_3
detect mCherryDetection on transduction_1_6  for 30s -> signal_1_6
detect mCherryDetection on transduction_1_12 for 30s -> signal_1_12
detect mCherryDetection on transduction_1_24 for 30s -> signal_1_24
if (signal_1_3 > 0) { dispose x4 } else { drain x4 }
steps.description: Detect mCherry fluorescence on each transduction site. QC gate on 1:3 dilution signal: pass disposes transduction droplets, fail drains them. All signal droplets disposed unconditionally at join block.
steps.titer_formula: TU/mL = (# cells transduced x % fluorescent x dilution factor) / transduction volume (mL)

qc_gate.note: drain lowered to dispose in IR by lilott8/BioScript compiler; .bs source is semantically correct

steps.name: shRNA Knockdown Assay (Optional)
bs_ops: repeat mastermix build (Steps 2-3) with fresh producer cells
detect geneKnockdownDetection on shrnaCells for 30s -> shrnaSignal
if (shrnaSignal > 0) { dispose shrnaCells } else { drain shrnaCells }
steps.description: Replace transfer plasmid with MISSION shRNA plasmid targeting ESR1. Fresh producer and target cell droplets dispensed independently (use-once compliance). Cells retrieved by trypsinization and cultured 7 days with puromycin before qRT-PCR.
steps.nontarget_control: nontarget shRNA plasmid (not targeting any known genes)

cell_harvest.wash: 5 uL PBS aspirated with Pasteur pipette
cell_harvest.detachment: 2 uL Trypsin-EDTA (0.25% w/v), 2 min at 37C with 5% CO2
cell_harvest.pooling: 2 microwells per dilution resuspended in 10 uL complete medium
cell_harvest.expansion: 96-well plate, 100 uL complete medium per well

steps.name: CRISPR-Cas9 Knockout Assay (Optional)
bs_ops: repeat mastermix build (Steps 2-3) with fresh producer cells
detect mCherryDetection on crisprCells for 30s -> crisprMCherry
if (crisprMCherry > 0) { dispose crisprCells } else { drain crisprCells }
steps.description: Replace transfer plasmid with LCMNv2 all-in-one Cas9 + sgRNA plasmid. Fresh producer and target cell droplets dispensed independently (use-once compliance). Cells retrieved by trypsinization for genomic cleavage assay at day 7.

cell_harvest.wash: 5 uL PBS aspirated with Pasteur pipette
cell_harvest.detachment: 2 uL Trypsin-EDTA (0.25% w/v), 2 min at 37C with 5% CO2
cell_harvest.expansion: 96-well plate, 100 uL complete medium per well

compiler_notes.antlr4_encoding: ASCII only - no Unicode characters permitted anywhere in .bs file including comments
compiler_notes.heat_semantics: void statement - no assignment; variable name remains valid after heat call
compiler_notes.drain_vs_dispose_in_ir: lilott8/BioScript ir_target lowers both drain and dispose to dispose() opcode; distinction is preserved in .bs source only
compiler_notes.use_once_type_system: every variable consumed on first use; separate dispense required per branch and per dilution
compiler_notes.cfg_fall_through: true-branch (_t) falls through to join block; false-branch (_f) emits explicit jump
